The '''White Knights' Castle''' is the centre of [[Falador]] and base of the [[White Knights]], who are a major political force in [[Asgarnia]] and loyal to [[Saradomin]].

If the player has completed [[Recruitment Drive]], they can talk to [[Sir Tiffy Cashien]] and make the castle their [[Spawning#Respawn_point|respawn point]].

==People==
*[[Sir Amik Varze]] - Regent of Asgarnia and leader of the White Knights.
*[[Sir Vyvin]] - Runs the [[White Knight Armoury]].
*[[Squire]] - Sir Vyvin's squire.
*[[Sir Renitee]] - Provides heraldry service and sells [[Hall (quest trophies)|quest hall]] items.
*[[Sir Rebral]] - Taskmaster for the [[Falador Diary]].
*[[Ambassador Spanfipple]] - [[Gnome]] ambassador.

==Monsters==
*[[White Knight]] (levels 36, 38, 39, and 42)
*[[Chicken]] (level 1)

==Quests==
*[[The Knight's Sword]]
*[[Black Knights' Fortress]]
*[[Recruitment Drive]]
*[[While Guthix Sleeps]]

==Other==
*[[Crypt (White Knights' Castle)|White Knights' Castle Crypt]] - Squire [[Squire (Crypt)|Vicks]] can be found here; portal to [[Death's Office]] at the end of the crypt.

==Trivia==
*There are four different ranks of [[White Knight|white knights]] within the castle: initiate, proselyte, acolyte, and partisan. Their helmets' plume colour corresponds to their rank.
*In the [[2018 Birthday event]], the player has to fish a [[semi-precious blue gem]] out of the moat around the castle. According to [[Sir Amik Varze]] and [[Herquin]], the reason for their being gems in the moat is because hundreds of years ago, when a knight died, a sword would be sacrificed to the moat. Initially they sacrificed the knight's own sword, but later switched to using cheap swords with semi-precious gems on them, as it was the gesture that counted.
